parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked PCRE documentation for pcre_exec: the ovector array size is limited by the number of capturing groups in the regex, not by the subject string length. The function will not write beyond the supplied ovecsize; if the pattern contains more than 9 capturing groups (i.e., requires more than 30 ints), pcre_exec returns PCRE_ERROR_NOMEM. The subject string length is not used to index ovector, so a long subject cannot overflow it.
